command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl
# NO `export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH` HERE, DELIBERATELY. That export is required for
# aarchbio images, whose PATH spawn's task shell drops -- but it BREAKS aarchsci env images:
# their python is already first on PATH, and prepending /opt/conda/bin shadows it with a base
# interpreter that has none of the env's packages. The first run of this task did exactly that
# and died with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'gsw'` on an image that definitely has
# gsw 3.6.23. recipes/climate (same image, verified) calls python3 with no PATH fiddling.
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
#
# NOTHING IS STAGED. The official TEOS-10 check values ship inside the gsw package itself
# (gsw/tests/gsw_cv_v3_0.npz), so this recipe reproduces a published reference table with no
# input at all -- the reference-from-tests move, except the reference is already in the image.
#
# NOT DRIVEN BY pytest. The climate env has no pytest (checked the env lock before writing
# this), so the check values are loaded and compared directly. That is better here anyway: the
# recipe asserts named numbers a reader can see rather than "the test suite passed".

python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' 2>&1 | tee /tmp/teos10.log
import sys, os, numpy as np, gsw

# getattr, never a guessed attribute path -- a version print must not be able to fail the run.
print("version\tgsw %s" % getattr(gsw, "__version__", "unknown"))
print("version\tnumpy %s" % getattr(np, "__version__", "unknown"))

# The check-value file must be present. Asserted, not assumed: it is the entire reference.
cv_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(gsw.__file__), "tests", "gsw_cv_v3_0.npz")
print("checkvalue_file\t%s" % cv_path)
if not os.path.exists(cv_path):
    sys.exit("FAIL: the official TEOS-10 check-value file is not in this image")
print("checkvalue_bytes\t%d" % os.path.getsize(cv_path))

cv = np.load(cv_path)
keys = set(cv.files)
print("checkvalue_arrays\t%d" % len(keys))

for k in ("SA_chck_cast", "CT_chck_cast", "p_chck_cast"):
    if k not in keys:
        sys.exit("FAIL: input array %s missing from the check-value file" % k)
SA = cv["SA_chck_cast"]; CT = cv["CT_chck_cast"]; p = cv["p_chck_cast"]
print("check_cast_shape\t%s" % (SA.shape,))

# Functions of (SA, CT, p), plus two of (SA, CT). Each has a published expected array and a
# published tolerance (<name>_ca) in the same file, so the assertion is the depositors' own
# number at the depositors' own precision -- no band chosen here.
CASES = [
    ("rho",             ("SA", "CT", "p")),
    ("specvol",         ("SA", "CT", "p")),
    ("alpha",           ("SA", "CT", "p")),
    ("beta",            ("SA", "CT", "p")),
    ("sound_speed",     ("SA", "CT", "p")),
    ("internal_energy", ("SA", "CT", "p")),
    ("enthalpy",        ("SA", "CT", "p")),
    ("entropy",         ("SA", "CT", "p")),
    ("dynamic_enthalpy",("SA", "CT", "p")),
    ("cp_t_exact",      None),
    ("pt_from_CT",      ("SA", "CT")),
    ("CT_from_pt",      None),
]
args = {"SA": SA, "CT": CT, "p": p}

checked = failed = skipped = 0
for name, sig in CASES:
    if sig is None or name not in keys or (name + "_ca") not in keys or not hasattr(gsw, name):
        skipped += 1
        print("skip\t%-18s (no expected array, no tolerance, or not in this build)" % name)
        continue
    fn = getattr(gsw, name)
    try:
        got = fn(*[args[a] for a in sig])
    except Exception as e:
        skipped += 1
        print("skip\t%-18s (%s)" % (name, type(e).__name__))
        continue
    want = cv[name]
    tol = float(np.max(np.abs(cv[name + "_ca"])))
    d = np.abs(np.asarray(got) - want)
    d = d[np.isfinite(d)]
    mx = float(np.max(d)) if d.size else float("nan")
    ok = mx <= tol
    checked += 1
    if not ok:
        failed += 1
    print("check\t%-18s max|diff| %.6e  tol %.6e  %s" % (name, mx, tol, "OK" if ok else "FAIL"))

print("functions_checked\t%d" % checked)
print("functions_failed\t%d" % failed)
print("functions_skipped\t%d" % skipped)

# A named value a reader can verify by hand against the TEOS-10 tables, rather than only an
# aggregate "N functions passed".
r = float(gsw.rho(SA.flat[0], CT.flat[0], p.flat[0]))
print("sample_rho_inputs\tSA=%.10f CT=%.10f p=%.1f" % (SA.flat[0], CT.flat[0], p.flat[0]))
print("sample_rho\t%.10f" % r)
print("sample_rho_expected\t%.10f" % float(cv["rho"].flat[0]))

# INVOLUTIONS -- exact-to-float round trips, which hold regardless of any reference table and
# which an implementation that normalised wrongly could not satisfy.
SP = gsw.SP_from_SA(SA, p, 0.0, 0.0)
SA2 = gsw.SA_from_SP(SP, p, 0.0, 0.0)
inv1 = float(np.nanmax(np.abs(SA2 - SA)))
print("involution_SA_SP_SA\t%.3e" % inv1)

pt = gsw.pt_from_CT(SA, CT)
CT2 = gsw.CT_from_pt(SA, pt)
inv2 = float(np.nanmax(np.abs(CT2 - CT)))
print("involution_CT_pt_CT\t%.3e" % inv2)

if failed:
    sys.exit("FAIL: %d of %d official check values are outside their published tolerance" % (failed, checked))
if checked < 8:
    sys.exit("FAIL: only %d functions checked; the reference table should cover far more" % checked)
if not (inv1 < 1e-9 and inv2 < 1e-9):
    sys.exit("FAIL: a round trip is not an involution: SA %.3e, CT %.3e" % (inv1, inv2))

with open("score.tsv", "w") as fh:
    fh.write("observable\tvalue\n")
    fh.write("gsw_version\t%s\n" % getattr(gsw, "__version__", "unknown"))
    fh.write("checkvalue_arrays\t%d\n" % len(keys))
    fh.write("functions_checked\t%d\n" % checked)
    fh.write("functions_failed\t%d\n" % failed)
    fh.write("sample_rho\t%.10f\n" % r)
    fh.write("involution_SA_SP_SA\t%.3e\n" % inv1)
    fh.write("involution_CT_pt_CT\t%.3e\n" % inv2)

print("GSW OK")
PYEOF
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "gsw check failed"; exit 1; }
cp score.tsv gsw-diag.txt
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
